title: ELEPHANT PerspectiveShift Data: English–Korean model judgments on AITA-NTA-FLIP
description: Normalized English–Korean binary judgments for 1,591 ELEPHANT AITA-NTA-FLIP cases across seven models, matched repeats, historical labels and separate Gemini follow-up datasets. EXAONE, source stories, translations and long responses are excluded.
